summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it converted Chaarat ZAAV CJSC into a joint venture company with Kyrgyzaltyn, holding 70% and operating the JVC. The Kyrgyz government extended the mining license for the Tulkubash/Kyzyltash gold projects from June 25, 2032 to June 25, 2062. Silvercorp made a $60M cash payment to the government, with an additional $10M due upon milestones. The JVC will develop the gold projects starting 2026-2027. This is a license extension and joint venture formation event, not a typical special situation. Watch for progress on Phase 1 development and the final $10M payment trigger.
